symptom: A position can be healthier after collateral is added or price rises, yet a debt-increase simulation still fails the stored maximum-borrowing-capacity check.
prerequisites: The position is active and its stored capacity was established by open/refinance or reduced by collateral withdrawal.
Ordinary collateral and ratio checks may pass while the requested debt exceeds the stored capacity.
diagnosticSteps: Read the stored position capacity and current entire debt at the same block as collateral, price, and mode inputs.
Evaluate the debt-increase preconditions from the canonical borrowing operation instead of deriving capacity only from current collateral ratio.
Simulate the exact debt-increase entrypoint and retain the decoded revert if the stored-capacity boundary is exceeded.
expected: An integrator that derives borrowable amount only from current collateral and price expects the capacity to grow automatically.
observed: The deployed-source model retains the stored snapshot across ordinary collateral top-ups and price increases; the bounded update and reset paths are owned by the borrowing operation catalog.
control: Pinned official tests cover price-rise rejection above stored capacity, downward-only collateral-withdrawal behavior, and refinance reset behavior.
verifiedCause: The contract intentionally gates debt increase with stored position state rather than an always-recomputed current-collateral maximum. Exact update/reset semantics are canonical in the borrowing operation catalog.
safeMitigation: Read and expose the stored capacity, include it in the quote block, and fail closed before signing. Do not substitute a UI current-ratio estimate or bypass exact-call simulation. Refinance is a separate state-changing operation with fees and safety checks, not an automatic workaround.

testLocators: withdrawMUSD: reverts when withdrawal exceeds maxBorrowingCapacity after price increase
adjustTrove: does not increase maxBorrowingCapacity on collateral withdrawal even if price has risen
refinance: updates maxBorrowingCapacity from current collateral and price

limitations: This is deployed protocol behavior for the scoped source/deployments, not an RPC failure.
Do not recommend refinance without a fresh fee, mode, ICR/TCR, and transaction review.
